patch_description: The current candidate collapsed ry_a/ry_b and rz_a/rz_b into single shared parameters and dropped the CRZ entangling layer entirely, which regressed the score from 0.42 to 0.39 (lower validation accuracy and margin). This edit restores the higher-performing structure from the earlier generation (separate ry_a/ry_b and rz_a/rz_b parameters plus the shared CRZ(ent) layer on disjoint pairs), which is known to reach 0.42. On top of that, following the recommendation, we insert a parallel CRX(f) layer immediately after the CRZ(ent) layer using the same disjoint pairs [0,1],[2,3],[4,5],[6,7] with a new shared parameter f. This enriches the non-Clifford entangling structure at very low parameter cost (only 1 extra distinct parameter), which should improve robust separation on harder validation groups while keeping parameter count economical (7 distinct params total).
